meta.name: Three-machine line
meta.description: Parts are cut, wait in a buffer of 10 places, are welded, moved on a 2 min transfer, then painted (examples/three_machine_line.json with the buffer added). Parts arrive 30 per hour (exponential, mean 2 min); cut 1.2 min, weld 1.8 min and paint 1 min, exponential. The weld station takes parts only from the buffer, which blocks cut when it is full. Every station passes 30 per hour, so utilization = arrival rate x mean service time: weld 0.90, paint 0.50; cut's includes the time it is blocked. The run is 100 h long including 20 h of warm-up, so 80 h are measured.
